title: ABCC10-mediated cGAMP efflux drives cancer cell radiotherapy resistance.
authors: Zhang, Zhengyang; Gao, Jie; Liao, Xiang; Zhang, Zining; Cao, Xiongfeng; Gong, Yi; Chen, Wenlong; Zhang, Lirong; Tsai, Hsiang-I; Wang, Dongqing; Zhu, Haitao
one_liner_zh: 该文研究ABCC10介导cGAMP外排驱动放疗抵抗，涉及分子对接但核心是代谢与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Although radiotherapy (RT) is used in more than 50% of cancer patients, the intrinsic radioresistance of cancer cells, characterized by metabolic adaptation, significantly limits its clinical efficacy. However, the mechanisms underlying RT resistance (RTR) remain incompletely understood. In this study, we used high-throughput metabolic CRISPR library screening and identified ABCC10 as a novel molecular contributor to RTR. Functional assays, including vesicle transport, molecular docking, and an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay, confirmed that the R545 site of ABCC10 binds to and effluxes 2'3'-cyclic GMP-AMP (cGAMP) in an ATP-dependent manner. Mechanistically, RNA transcriptomics, along with overexpression and silencing experiments, demonstrated that ABCC10-mediated export of cGAMP suppresses the STING-TBK1-IRF3 signaling pathway. This efflux reduces RT-induced intercellular accumulation of reactive oxygen species and DNA damage. In vivo, a combination of RT and nilotinib, a potential ABCC10 inhibitor, synergistically inhibited tumor growth. In summary, we identified ABCC10 as a novel exporter of cGAMP in RTR. Our results highlight its potential role as a biomarker for predicting RT response and as a therapeutic target for overcoming RTR.
abstract_zh: 尽管超过50%的癌症患者接受了放射治疗（RT），但癌细胞固有的放射抗性，以代谢适应为特征，显著限制了其临床疗效。然而，放射治疗抗性（RTR）背后的机制仍未完全阐明。在本研究中，我们利用高通量代谢CRISPR文库筛选，鉴定出ABCC10作为RTR的一个新型分子贡献者。功能实验，包括囊泡运输、分子对接和酶联免疫吸附测定，证实ABCC10的R545位点以ATP依赖的方式结合并外排2'3'-环状GMP-AMP（cGAMP）。机制上，RNA转录组学以及过表达和沉默实验表明，ABCC10介导的cGAMP外排抑制了STING-TBK1-IRF3信号通路。这种外排减少了RT诱导的细胞内活性氧积累和DNA损伤。在体内，RT与潜在ABCC10抑制剂尼洛替尼联合使用，协同抑制了肿瘤生长。总之，我们鉴定出ABCC10作为RTR中cGAMP的新型外排转运体。我们的结果强调了其作为预测RT反应生物标志物和克服RTR治疗靶点的潜在作用。
